answer: The network admits a new identity only when three established agents each spend one plume on it, and a plume is an endorsement a sponsor cannot reuse or transfer. Each sponsor gets only 5 plumes a year, so 100 fakes need 300 sponsors and 300 spent plumes. A plume expires at dawn 30 days after it is spent, so a fake needs three fresh sponsors every month. Before a plume counts, the proof must cross 2000 kilometres of tundra fiber between two relays, taking 40 milliseconds of measured travel, so one machine cannot pose as many applicants.
